description: Class representing the table row properties.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiTableRowPr class.

SetHeight.description: Sets the height to the current table row within the current table.

params.description: The rule to apply the height value to the current table row or ignore it.
params.name: sHRule

params.description: The height for the current table row measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).
params.name: nValue

SetTableHeader.description: Specifies that the current table row will be repeated at the top of each new page wherever this table is displayed.

params.description: The true value means that the current table row will be repeated at the top of each new page.
params.name: isHeader
